Most-protective tier with a 2022 shield law covering travellers, custody treated by identity since 2018, hate-crime and non-discrimination law. Offsets much state-level exposure; national border/document regime still binds.

Deepest protective stack: GENDA plus 2024 constitutional amendment, shield law, custody and facility protections, repealed cross-dressing arrest statute. Best local layer; national passport/entry/custody exposure persists regardless.

State adds a hostile layer on the parent's regime: enforced minor-care ban upheld 2026, Medicaid bar, custody care denial with no taper, licence/15-year-liability exposure, document rules reverted to surgery requirement, no GI non-discrimination. High Risk band.
